name: Secure Admin Email Change
author: Priyank Sukhadiya

sections.description:
This plugin let’s administrators to change the site admin email instantly without needing email verification. This plugin enables you to:

  • Change Admin Email Instantly – No email confirmation required.
  • Easy & Quick Configuration – Update via Settings → General
  • Test Email Feature – Verify new admin email before change email.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to verify and notify about admin email changes before updating the email in WordPress.

  • Service: Secure Admin Email Change API
  • Purpose: This service is used to verify and send a notification when the admin email is changed, ensuring transparency and security.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the new email address and the associated domain name to the API, which then verifies the email and sends a notification regarding the email change.
  • Service Provider: Primal Devs (https://blog.primaldevs.com)
  • Privacy Policy: (https://primaldevs.com/saec-privacy-policy.html)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the secure-admin-email-change folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Secure Admin Email Change in the WordPress admin menu to configure the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
How do I change admin email?

Go to Settings -> General in the WordPress admin area. From Administration Email Address, there you can change admin email.
